answer: Proposal: pay per verified sequential core-time, not per key. A paid identity streams a delay-puzzle chain seeded by its public key — a fresh signal each slot, checked on-chain; gaps void it, and one core cannot advance two chains at once, so k keys need k cores per epoch. Extra keys harbor no free share: only the key-bound chain counts, so each reward unit is bought with proven core-hours at one price. Keep pool-per-core-hour below market core rental and farming nets a per-epoch loss. Weakness: botnets still earn their real core-time; no ivory-tower clone detector assumed.
